title: Intune Administrative Governance — RBAC & Multi-Admin Approval
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Intune RBAC custom roles + scope tags + multi-admin / access-policy approval; governance, multi-stakeholder).
hook: Put real guardrails on Intune — least-privilege roles and a second pair of eyes on risky changes
problem: When everyone is an Intune Administrator, mistakes and blast radius follow. Modern governance means least-privilege RBAC and multi-admin approval for the changes that can break a fleet. This solution implements Intune administrative governance: custom RBAC roles and scope tags that limit who can touch what, plus access policies (multi-admin approval) so high-risk actions — like app or script deployments — require a second admin to approve before they go live.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Intune RBAC model (built-in vs custom roles, permissions, scope tags, scope groups), the multi-admin approval / access-policy model, and how the two combine into least-privilege governance.
Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, an admin-role design, scope-tag taxonomy, approver groups, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: design roles and scope tags, create custom RBAC roles and assignments, apply scope tags to objects, enable access policies (multi-admin approval) for high-risk resource types, validate approvals, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — RBAC/scope-tag and access-policy discovery, role-assignment and approval validation, a governance-coverage and privilege report, safe remediation of over-privileged assignments, and an admin/approver scope-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Implement Intune administrative governance — least-privilege custom RBAC roles and scope tags, plus multi-admin approval (access policies) so high-risk changes need a second admin. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Implement Intune administrative governance — least-privilege custom RBAC roles and scope tags, plus multi-admin approval so high-risk changes need a second admin.
meta_title: Intune Administrative Governance — RBAC & Multi-Admin Approval
meta_description: Govern Intune with least-privilege RBAC (custom roles + scope tags) and multi-admin approval (access policies) for high-risk app/script changes. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Intune locked down to least privilege — custom roles and scope tags limiting who can touch what, and a required second-admin approval on high-risk changes — so mistakes and blast radius shrink, proven on a pilot before you scale.
